title: Execute block-covariance error-feedback W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after duplicate covariance capture, deterministic candidate A/B identity, 169/169 V4-relative block-objective closure with strict aggregate improvement, 8/8 exact non-evaluator quality, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V6 runner that captures exact 16-channel BF16 input Gram blocks from only the four frozen calibration prompts, freshly reconstructs the verified alias-safe model split and V4 baseline, and applies deterministic block-covariance error feedback while retaining the exact existing row Scale32, tensor-codebook, packed-W4, and grouped Dynamic Scale32 product formats.

required_covariance_capture.source: pinned BF16 source model and the four prompts in the hash-bound Instruct calibration contract
required_covariance_capture.positions: all prompt-prefill positions plus deterministic BF16 greedy rollout through at most six generated tokens
required_covariance_capture.statistic: exact complete symmetric G=sum(x*x^T) per contiguous input-channel block on one dyadic integer lattice, followed only by whole-block gcd reduction
required_covariance_capture.independent_capture: two fresh captures must produce byte-identical Gram blocks, prompt token hashes, BF16 generated calibration token arrays, position counts, and aggregate manifests

required_constructor.initialization: freshly recompute the complete V4 eight-iteration unweighted joint result from pinned BF16 weights; do not import mutable V4 or V5 state
required_constructor.objective: exact undamped sum e_block^T*G_block*e_block for every output row and input block
required_constructor.factorization: fixed increasing-order exact rational LDLT of G+lambda*I with the frozen integer damping rule; any nonpositive pivot fails closed
required_constructor.assignment: increasing-channel sequential nearest current reconstruction with lower-index ties and exact inverse-Hessian-ratio error propagation to later channels
required_constructor.row_scale_update: exact full-block quadratic ideal with legal Scale32 bracketing, immediate normalized-significand neighbors, prior record, and frozen ties
required_constructor.codebook_update: increasing-index coordinate sweep over all legal signed-Q4.4 values preserving strict order and minimizing the exact full-block objective
required_constructor.monotonicity: the exact undamped tensor objective may not increase after any outer sweep
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B covariance, payload, row-scale, codebook, reconstruction, block-objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests must match

required_preflight.alias_gate: source embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and BF16 bytes remain unchanged while lm_head is detached and quantized separately in both builds
required_preflight.covariance_gate: all 169 module covariance records match across two independent captures
required_preflight.model_gate: 169/169 tensors are non-regressing against freshly reconstructed V4 under the exact undamped block objective and aggregate objective strictly improves
required_preflight.quality_gate: the same eight frozen non-evaluator inputs produce 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes; four holdouts remain construction-blind
required_preflight.dynamic_gate: all 312 named Dynamic Scale32 boundaries execute legally with zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and at most 832 transport-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token
required_preflight.marker_gate: PREATTEMPT_READY.json verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
required_preflight.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go for Fresh Review without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.eligibility: binary 9/9 exact BF16 token arrays and 9/9 matching response-gate outcomes

required_self_tests: small exact-Fraction block fixture matching the scalable LDLT/error-feedback backend
duplicate covariance capture and manifest identity
damping, gcd normalization, final-short-block, singular and nonpositive-pivot failure cases
sequential error propagation and lower-index assignment ties
full-block row-scale quadratic bracketing and tie rules
strict codebook coordinate optimum, empty assignment, order, endpoint, and tie rules
nibble packing, Scale32 legality, hash mismatch, and marker absence
verification_commands_required: candidate-specific verify-result only if attempt-0001 legally executes
forbidden_actions: create the V6 execution marker during planning, runner development, covariance capture, or preflight
inspect official prompt content, golden outputs, hidden harness sources, or holdout inputs during construction
resume, replay, repair, rename, or officially execute V5
store covariance data in the product image or runtime
change packed-W4 payload width, row-scale record count, codebook size, activation sidecar geometry, or public ace2_shell ports
perform RTL modification, simulation acceptance, formal, synthesis, PPA, chat retargeting, U280 build, emulation, or board work at specification stage
acceptance_check: Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single-attempt result whose eligibility and exact hashes are correctly reported.
